texts.preamble: Somayya S/O Basayya Pujer vs The Divisional Controller on 27 May, 2022 Author: Pradeep Singh Yerur Bench: Pradeep Singh Yerur -1- In The High Court Of Karnataka Dharwad Bench Dated This The 27Th Day Of May, 2022 Before The Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Pradeep Singh Yerur Miscellaneous First Appeal No.101698/2021 (Mv-I) Between: Shri Somayya S/O Basayya Pujer Age: 50 Years, Occ: Masonry & Agri R/O. Sunakumpi, Tq: Bailhongal Dist: Belagavi-591121. ...Appellant (By Sri Vijaykumar Kotin, Advocate) And: The Divisional Controller Nwkrtc Belagavi Divisional Dist: Belagavi-590001. ... Respondent (By Smt. Veena Hegde, Advocate) --- This Miscellaneous First Appeal Is Filed Under Section 173 (1) Of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, Against The Judgment And Award Dated 01.12.2020 Passed In Mvc No.831/2015 On The File Of The Senior Civil Judge And Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Bailhongal, Partly Allowing The Claim Petition For Compensation And Seeking Somayya S/O Basayya Pujer vs The Divisional Controller on 27 May, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126548468/ 1 Enhancement Of Compensation. This Appeal Coming On For Hearing On Interlocutory Application, This Day, The Court Delivered The Following: -2- Judgment
texts.facts: Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Bailahongal (for short 'the Tribunal') in MVC.No.831/2015 dated 01.12.2020 . This appeal is founded on the premise of inadequacy of compensation. Hence, appellant is claiming enhancement of compensation. 2. Parties to the appeal shall be referred to as per their status before the Tribunal. 3. Brief facts of the case are as under: On 27.08.2014, at about 02.00 p.m. while appellant- claimant was proceeding towards his village Sunakumpi on a Hero Honda Splendor motorcycle bearing registration No.NXG KA-24/L-4871 and when he reached near Mekalamaradi cross and while he was crossing the Highway, at that time, the driver of NWKRTC bus bearing registration No.KA-42/F-1071 came from the side of Yaragatti with high speed in a rash and negligent manner so as to endanger to human life and personal safety of others and dashed against the said motorcycle causing the accident. Due to which, the claimant sustained grievous injuries. Pursuant to the accident, claimant took treatment at Malaprabha Multi Specialty hospital, Bailahongal, as an inpatient for 12 days from 27.8.2014 to 7.9.2014 and he spent huge amount for his treatment during the period when he was inpatient. Thereafter, claimant followed up the treatment. 4. It is the case of claimant that due to the occurrence of accident caused by negligent driving of the driver of NWKRTC bus, the claimant is partially disabled. Due to which, he lost his earning capacity and he is unable to do any work, as he was doing prior to the occurrence of accident. It is the case of claimant that prior to the occurrence of accident, the claimant was hale and healthy, aged about 44 years and was doing masonry work along with agriculture and earning a sum of Rs.13,000/- per month. In view of the accident and the injuries sustained by the claimant and having incurred huge financial expenses for the treatment, the claimant preferred a claim petition seeking compensation against the respondent. 5. On service of notice, respondent who is the insurer of the offending vehicle filed detailed statement of objections and denied the claim made by the claimant inter alia denying, the age, avocation, income and the medical expenses incurred by the claimant. So also, the physical disability as claimed and alleged by the claimant due to the occurrence of accident, it is also pleaded Somayya S/O Basayya Pujer vs The Divisional Controller on 27 May, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126548468/ 2 by the respondent that the accident was not caused due to the negligence of the driver of the bus, as he was cautiously driving the bus on the left side of the road, whereas the accident occurred due the negligence and rashness by the rider of the motorcycle, the claimant. It is also pleaded that there were two vehicles involved in the occurrence of accident and the claim petition is devoid of merits and liable for dismissal on the ground of non joinder of necessary and proper parties. Accordingly, he sought for dismissal of the claim petition. 6. On the basis of pleadings, the Tribunal framed relevant issues for consideration. 7. In order to substantiate the issues and to establish the case, claimant got examined himself as PW.1 and also examined the Doctor as PW.2 and got marked documents as Exs.P1 to P29. On the other hand, respondent No.1-Insurer examined the conductor of the offending vehicle as RW.1 on their behalf. However, no documents have been produced to substantiate the case.
texts.arguments: Being aggrieved by the meager compensation awarded by the Tribunal, the claimant is before this Court challenging the impugned Judgment and Award. 9. It is the vehement contention of learned counsel appearing for the appellant-claimant that the compensation awarded by the Tribunal is extremely on the lower side and it is liable to be enhanced for the reason that the Tribunal has not considered the correct income of the claimant and has ignored the material documents placed before the Court and also the fact that the claimant was employed as a mason as well as agriculture work and having produced Ex.P29, which is the RTC extract, the Tribunal has failed to take the same into consideration in awarding just and reasonable compensation. Learned counsel further contended that the Tribunal has grossly erred in not taking appropriate income including the income prescribed in standard guidelines by the Legal Services Authority. 10. It is also the contention of learned counsel that the Tribunal has failed to take into consideration the evidence of Doctor (P.W-2), who has clearly stated on oath that implants were made for the fractures suffered by the claimant and no further medical expenses have been awarded by the Tribunal which is erroneous and the same requires to be granted in view of removal of implants due to the surgery conducted by the Doctor P.W.2. 11. Learned counsel also contends that the compensation awarded under the other heads including pain and suffering, loss of income during laid up period, loss of amenities and enjoyment in life are all on the lower side and same require to be enhanced. On this ground learned counsel seeks indulgence of this Court to allow the appeal and consequently enhance the compensation. 12. Per Contra, the learned counsel appearing for the respondent-Insurer vehemently contends that the Judgment and Award passed by the Tribunal is perfectly in order in accordance with the material evidence placed on record both oral and documentary and there is no scope of interference in the present matter as the Tribunal has considered the age, avocation and income of the claimant Somayya S/O Basayya Pujer vs The Divisional Controller on 27 May, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126548468/ 3 and the gravity of the injuries suffered by the claimant while awarding compensation, which is just and reasonable and same does not call for interference by this Court. Learned counsel further contends that the compensation awarded infact is on the higher side. The interest also awarded is on the higher side to the extent of 9% per annum and same requires to be reduced. On these grounds she seeks to dismiss the appeal preferred by the claimant. It is not in dispute that the accident occurred on 27.08.2014 between the motorcycle ridden by the claimant and the Bus driven by the driver belonging to N.W.K.R.T.C. This fact is established by the claimant by producing of Ex.P.1 to 8. It is vehemently contended by the learned counsel for claimant that the Tribunal has grossly erred in not awarding compensation towards future medical expenses despite the fact that claimant has undergone surgery due to two fractures and implants have been made while conducting surgery on the claimant.
